name: Hydration and humidifier for voice
lead: Hydration and humidifier use for the voice is a set of practices, drinking water and humidifying room air, that people adopt in the belief that moist vocal folds work better and recover faster. A study of karaoke singers examined hydration together with vocal rest in relation to vocal fatigue. [1]
Humidifiers are described generally as helping with dry mucous membranes and cough, but also carry contamination and overuse risks. [2]

paras: Wikipedia reports that humidifiers can help prevent dry mucous membranes and cough, that most homes should stay around 30-50% relative humidity, and that the EPA says ultrasonic and impeller types spread the most minerals and microorganisms. Overuse can promote mold and dust mites and has been linked to hypersensitivity pneumonitis. [2]

A 2003 Journal of Voice study looked at the effect of hydration and vocal rest on vocal fatigue in amateur karaoke singers. [1] No dedicated trials of room humidifiers for appearance-related voice goals were found.

refs.title: Effect of hydration and vocal rest on the vocal fatigue in amateur karaoke singers

card.summary: Drinking water and humidifying the room to keep vocal folds moist; studied only loosely, and humidifiers need upkeep.
card.note: Dirty or overused humidifiers can cause problems.

quick.overview:
Hydration and humidifiers are used to keep the voice comfortable and less fatigued.

One small study of karaoke singers tested hydration with rest; little else is specific to this use.
quick.mechanism: Proponents say moisture lubricates the vocal folds; humidifiers add moisture to air.
quick.risks: Humidifiers can spread microorganisms if unclean and promote mold when humidity is too high. [2]
